mask_year_meaning: Reporting footprint; not the thickness measurement year.
sampling: Rasterio all_touched=False on the existing working grid.
coverage_denominator: Glacier-labelled land pixels outside the lagoon mask.
missing_data: Excluded from statistics; absent outlines explicitly labelled.
spike_policy: Retained in statistics and reported as flagged pixel counts.
error_interpretation: Mean source error; not uncertainty of the glacier mean.
